# Dr. Adonis Maiquez, MD — Functional & Regenerative Medicine

> Dr. Adonis Maiquez, MD is a board-certified physician specializing in Functional Medicine and Anti-Aging & Regenerative Medicine in Miami, Florida. He is a former neurosurgeon, member of IFM, A4M, AAPM, and the World Institute of Pain.

## About

Dr. Adonis uses a functional medicine approach to identify the root causes of medical problems — from cognitive decline, weight gain, hormonal imbalance, chronic fatigue, to autoimmune and chronic degenerative diseases. His clinic offers comprehensive health solutions designed to treat the root cause, not just symptoms.
